changes.change: `pubkit crates` tries each upgrade on its own, on top of those already kept, so one unaudited crate no longer costs the audited ones; it takes no MSRV downgrades, handles crates locked at several versions, and gives each skipped crate its own reason (no audit, with what cargo vet recommends; cargo deny; or updatable only together with others)

comment: Changes not yet released. One row per change: category changed or removed (a published interface changed: major), added (a feature: minor), or fixed or security (patch). `pubrel add` appends one; `pubrel summary` sets the release's summary; `pubrel prepare` moves them into the package publet.
